tasks.label: sync and build
tasks.detail: ⌃⌥B — rsync to the bot, then make && make install
tasks.command: rsync -av --delete --exclude='.git' --exclude='obj' --exclude='bin' --exclude='node_modules' --exclude='__pycache__' --exclude='*.pyc' --exclude='.DS_Store' --exclude='_to_delete' --exclude='Claude outputs' --exclude='recordings' --exclude='logs' --exclude='bbot_dashboard.html' --exclude='robot.conf' --exclude='pidconfig.txt' ${workspaceFolder}/ boneblue-0:~/balance_bot/ && ssh boneblue-0 'cd ~/balance_bot && make && make install'

tasks.label: sync and build (no install)
tasks.detail: ⌃⌥N — rsync to the bot, then make only -- never touches the running service, even if the binary changed
tasks.command: rsync -av --delete --exclude='.git' --exclude='obj' --exclude='bin' --exclude='node_modules' --exclude='__pycache__' --exclude='*.pyc' --exclude='.DS_Store' --exclude='_to_delete' --exclude='Claude outputs' --exclude='recordings' --exclude='logs' --exclude='bbot_dashboard.html' --exclude='robot.conf' --exclude='pidconfig.txt' ${workspaceFolder}/ boneblue-0:~/balance_bot/ && ssh boneblue-0 'cd ~/balance_bot && make'

tasks.label: clean sync and build
tasks.detail: ⌃⌥⇧B — make clean on the bot, then sync, build and install
tasks.command: ssh boneblue-0 'cd ~/balance_bot && make clean' && rsync -av --delete --exclude='.git' --exclude='obj' --exclude='bin' --exclude='node_modules' --exclude='__pycache__' --exclude='*.pyc' --exclude='.DS_Store' --exclude='_to_delete' --exclude='Claude outputs' --exclude='recordings' --exclude='logs' --exclude='bbot_dashboard.html' --exclude='robot.conf' --exclude='pidconfig.txt' ${workspaceFolder}/ boneblue-0:~/balance_bot/ && ssh boneblue-0 'cd ~/balance_bot && make && make install'

tasks.label: get log
tasks.detail: ⌃⌥L — copy the 100 Hz ring (/dev/shm/bbot_ring_*.csv) off the bot into logs/

tasks.label: sync
tasks.detail: ⌃⌥S — rsync to the bot only, no build

tasks.label: build
tasks.detail: ⌃⌥K — make on the bot (no sync, no install)

tasks.label: build and install
tasks.detail: ⌃⌥I — make && make install on the bot (no sync)

tasks.label: install
tasks.detail: ⌃⌥P — make install on the bot

tasks.label: clean
tasks.detail: ⌃⌥C — make clean on the bot

tasks.label: install oled
tasks.detail: make install-oled on the bot (OLED status display only)

tasks.label: journal
tasks.detail: ⌃⌥J — follow the journal for balance_bot and the bridge

tasks.label: journal (this boot, errors only)
tasks.detail: ⌃⌥⇧J — priority warning and above since boot, across all three units
tasks.command: ssh -t boneblue-0 'journalctl -u balance_bot -u balance_bot_server -u bbot-watch -b -p warning --no-pager'

tasks.label: dmesg
tasks.detail: follow the kernel ring buffer — where start.sh writes its run stamps

tasks.label: run start.sh
tasks.detail: ⌃⌥⇧R — bench run on the bot. Prefer the 'bot: start.sh' terminal profile: Ctrl-C there reaches the cleanup trap instead of VS Code asking to kill the task.

tasks.label: run start.sh (control run)
tasks.detail: control condition — no input source, no server, tagged in the kernel log

tasks.label: service: restart
tasks.detail: ⌃⌥⇧I — restart balance_bot and the bridge, then show status
tasks.command: ssh -t boneblue-0 'sudo systemctl restart balance_bot balance_bot_server && sleep 1 && systemctl status balance_bot --no-pager -l | head -20'

tasks.label: service: stop
tasks.detail: ⌃⌥X — stop the bridge first, then the bot (Requires= drags it back otherwise)
tasks.command: ssh -t boneblue-0 'sudo systemctl stop balance_bot_server balance_bot && systemctl is-active balance_bot balance_bot_server || true'

tasks.label: service: status
tasks.detail: ⌃⌥⇧U — status of all three units
tasks.command: ssh -t boneblue-0 'systemctl status balance_bot balance_bot_server bbot-watch --no-pager -l | head -60'

tasks.label: run verbose (service stopped)
tasks.detail: Stops the service, runs balance_bot in the foreground with the SAME args minus -q, plus IMU+system blocks. Ctrl-C to quit; service stays stopped.
tasks.command: ssh -t boneblue-0 'sudo systemctl stop balance_bot balance_bot_server; . /etc/default/balance_bot 2>/dev/null; ARGS=$(echo "$BOT_ARGS" | sed s/-q//); echo "launching: balance_bot $ARGS -d imu -d sys"; echo; sudo /usr/local/bin/balance_bot $ARGS -d imu -d sys'

tasks.label: service: restart + watch log
tasks.detail: Restarts the service and follows its journal live. Production path — same args the bot boots with.
tasks.command: ssh -t boneblue-0 'sudo systemctl restart balance_bot balance_bot_server; journalctl -u balance_bot -u balance_bot_server -f -n 0 -o short-precise'

tasks.label: watch: arm + safety events
tasks.detail: Follows the journal filtered to arming, kickstand, IMU-stale, OOB and e-stop lines. Use while power-cycling.
tasks.command: ssh -t boneblue-0 'journalctl -u balance_bot -f -n 300 -o short-precise | grep --line-buffered -iE "arm_at_boot|kickstand|BLOCKED|STALE|OOB|estop|IMU|motors cut"'
